1. Never leave a friend behind
at the end of the night.
Everyone gets home.

2. Call on birthdays.
Don't text.
Your voice is the gift.

3. Keep your voice down
in public places.
Loud isn't strong.

4. Clean up after yourself,
everywhere.
The office, the gym, the hotel.

5. Greet everyone in the room,
not just the people you know.

6. Learn something every
morning. Ten minutes before
the world gets loud.
